name: Plastic Bottle
warning: Empty and rinse the bottle before disposal.

name: Glass Bottle
warning: Remove the cap before disposing.

name: Battery (AA/AAA)
warning: Never place batteries in general waste. They can leak and cause fires.

name: Newspaper
warning: Keep dry. Wet paper cannot be recycled.

name: Cardboard Box
warning: Flatten the box to save space.

name: Aluminium Can
warning: Crush the can to save space.

name: Smartphone
warning: Delete personal data and remove SIM card before disposal.

name: Laptop
warning: Back up your data and perform a factory reset before disposal.

name: Food Scraps
warning: Do not include cooked food or meat. Green waste only.

name: Old T-Shirt
warning: Only donate clean, wearable items. Torn items go to textile recycling.

name: Cooking Oil
warning: Never pour oil down the drain. Seal in a container first.

name: Paint Tin
warning: Leave the lid off so paint dries before disposal if empty.

name: Steel Food Can
warning: Rinse out food residue before placing in the bin.

name: Plastic Bag
warning: Most kerbside bins do not accept soft plastics. Use a dedicated soft plastic drop-off.

name: Light Bulb (LED)
warning: Handle carefully — some bulbs contain small amounts of mercury.

name: Egg Carton
warning: Paper egg cartons are recyclable. Foam cartons are not.

name: Jeans
warning: Donate if wearable; otherwise use a textile recycling bin.

name: Wine Bottle
warning: Separate by colour (clear / green / brown) if your local bank requires it.

name: Aerosol Can
warning: Never puncture or incinerate. Must be completely empty before disposal.

name: Banana Peel
warning: Great for composting. Speeds up compost decomposition.
